_doc: Every place a shipped module reaches outside the shipped tree: an import that is not
stdlib, a declared dependency or an in-tree module, or a sys.path / dynamic-load path
derived from outside the tree root. Enforced by tests/test_import_boundary.py, which
fails on an unregistered site, a stale entry and any entry whose visibility is silent.
visibility: visible (degrade shows in a doctor row, payload field or output),
fallback (an equivalent route gives the same result), optional (an opt-in extra),
dead_code (unreachable on supported Pythons), no_degrade (nothing depends on it).
doctor_row: the doctor label that must read WARN when doctor runs with an empty HOME.

scope: shared (default; the site exists in the export and in the public repo), export-only (export only; becomes shared the moment the public repo gains the site) or public-only (the public repo only). tests/test_import_boundary.py enforces presence per tree kind. visibility_test: optional pytest node id proving the degrade; checked to exist in the tree where the site applies.

test-governance-seam.degrade: None under pytest: the tree root is pytest's rootdir and is on sys.path, so agentica_core resolves in-tree; the exported suite passing in export-gate demonstrates it. The inserted directory is unused.

governance-root-seam.target: the directory above the shipped tree root (<monorepo>/Governance, where agentica_core lives in the monorepo)
governance-root-seam.reason: Monorepo seam: puts Governance/ on sys.path so `agentica_core` resolves from the monorepo layout.
governance-root-seam.degrade: In the public tree agentica_core is NOT in the inserted directory. The import after this insert resolves only when the tree root is already on sys.path (pytest, doctor, the reflex engine's working directory, or an installed package); run directly from an uninstalled clone it raises ModuleNotFoundError. Residual hazard: in a public clone the inserted directory is the clone's parent, so a same-named module there would shadow.
governance-root-seam.surface: ModuleNotFoundError traceback and non-zero exit (uncaught at this site)
